log.text: The public civil almanac dates 30 Seedwake 1156 AC.
A place is established in the lived world: Thistlebell Yard.

At first bell, Thistlebell Yard is already awake. Barley carts creak along the orchard road; the smell of bruised apples drifts from the presses, and water beads on the harness rails. Ten-year-old Maddoc Maddren is beside the public trough, where an ash-coated burden beast has planted all four feet and refuses to move. Two adult handlers argue in low voices about whether it has been overworked. Neither reaches for the animal. Beyond the yard, canal bells sound for the morning barges.

focus: Find Tessa and look for food in Mossgate Common with Bram
chatRuntime.scene: At 13:39, Maddoc and Bram sit at Mossgate Reading House, having spent 150 minutes reading Arcane Circle Architecture and Soul Cultivation. They completed handwritten notes on all nine Circles and all seven Soul phases. New practice-paper sheets remain at the table; taking them away has not been agreed. No powers were awakened. Tessa is at the practice yard, her intervening activities unknown.

journal.text: Maddoc said, 'Is arguing all you can do?' and began putting right the twisted harness. An ash-coated burden beast had a tight metal fitting rubbing its left shoulder raw. He loosened and straightened that strap; the animal remained at the trough and made no commitment to pull the cart. No new bond, injury, material or resources recorded.
After leaving the small seed-eating creature beneath the Rillbend culvert, Maddoc walked 16 minutes to Tansyhook Crossing (08:23). No other outcomes, resource or relationship changes.

Maddoc said 'Just follow me' and led willing companions Tessa and Bram to Mossgate Common. He is looking for books, training, or beast handling. Arrival recorded at 08:44, without rolling or granting access.
Maddoc and Bram complete introductory Meridian theory and handwritten notes at the reading house; time verified 11:04.
At 13:39 Maddoc and Bram completed reading and handwritten introductory notes for Arcane and Soul; no cultivation gain.
